summary: Backend: 17/17 pytest passed against external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL covering auth (register/login, admin auto-promotion, invalid login), services catalog (4 with prices 10000/5000/5000/5000), bookings (create→list role filtering→barber accept applies platform_fee=1000 and barber_earnings=price-1000), wallet for all 3 roles, chat (user send, admin reply with user_id required, threads grouping), admin stats/users/bookings, RBAC (403 for non-admin), and profile update. Frontend: Splash auto-navigates to /auth in ~3s. Customer login → /app shows customer-home with hero, 4 service tiles, FAB, and 5 bottom-nav items. Service tile opens booking-page. Barber login shows barber-dashboard (no pending requests because the only test booking was already accepted, expected). Wallet, Chat, Settings and Admin Dashboard all render with correct role-based bottom nav (5 tabs). Logout works.

integration_issues.flow: Customer booking via service tile -> confirm
integration_issues.issue: Clicking confirm-booking-btn did not navigate away from /app/book?service=full in test. Likely because address input was not filled (validation prevents submit). Recommend showing a visible inline error/toast when required fields (address, lat/lng) are empty so users understand why nothing happens.

action_items: Ensure Booking page surfaces a visible validation message/toast when address or location is missing on confirm (currently the button appears to silently no-op).
Optional: when booking is created via service tile (no address filled yet), pre-focus the address field and show inline guidance.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/bookings/{id}/status lacks state-machine guard: a barber could accept a booking already accepted by someone else (no check on current status or barber_id==None). Recommend conditional update: only set accepted+fee when current status=='pending' and barber_id is None.
JWT_SECRET falls back to a hardcoded default in code; recommend requiring it from env in production and failing fast if missing.
CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec; should restrict origins when credentials are allowed.
Wallet 'spent' for customer counts only accepted/completed/in_progress; clarify whether pending should be excluded (current logic is fine but document).

/api/auth/register returns user model but admin auto-promotion path stores role correctly via User(role=role); fine. However registering as 'admin' role via the API for any other email is allowed (RegisterIn.role: Role); consider rejecting role='admin' from public register to avoid privilege escalation.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_halaq.py is the regression suite (17 tests, all green). When re-running, the seeded barber's wallet will accumulate; tests are idempotent because they create fresh bookings each run. Booking confirm flow on frontend silently no-ops without address — main agent should add inline validation; retest the booking submit path after that.
rca of the issue: Booking page: confirm-booking-btn requires address (and lat/lng) to be present; when empty the click handler likely returns early without surfacing UI feedback, leaving users stuck on /app/book.
